**[1] `agent.threat.detection.action`:** `action` describes the decision at the detection point, not the eventual resolution of an approval flow. When an `ask` decision is later resolved by a human or external system to `allow` or `block`, the resolution SHOULD be recorded as a separate event or span rather than overwriting this attribute.

**[2] `agent.threat.detection.correlation_id`:** The value is opaque to this convention. Producers SHOULD use it to join to signed receipts, audit packets, OTLP trace IDs, or vendor-specific evidence stores without putting the underlying prompts, tool arguments, or business payloads directly into the span or event.
This attribute is intended for span and log/event use; it has unbounded cardinality and SHOULD NOT be used as a metric label.

**[3] `agent.threat.detection.rule_id`:** Rule identifiers are opaque strings owned by the ruleset author. Consumers MUST NOT attempt to parse meaning from the identifier shape; `agent.threat.detection.ruleset` is the only namespace anchor.

**[4] `agent.threat.detection.ruleset`:** The namespace is intentionally open-set. Open detection-rule libraries, vendor proprietary bundles, and locally-authored policy packs are peers in this convention. Consumers MUST NOT hardcode a particular ruleset prefix.

**[5] `agent.threat.detection.severity`:** Severity is a property of the rule itself, not the enforcement decision. A `high` rule may still result in `agent.threat.detection.action=allow` under a permissive policy, and a `low` rule may result in `block` under a strict policy.

---

`agent.threat.detection.action` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow` | Operation was permitted to proceed. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ask` | Operation paused for human or external approval. The absence of execution is intentional and successful, not a missing span or generic error. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `block` | Operation was denied. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `warn` | Operation proceeded; a concern was recorded for downstream review. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

---

`agent.threat.detection.severity` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |

| `critical` | Confirmed abuse pattern; warrants immediate enforcement. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `high` | Likely abuse; warrants blocking or approval routing in most policies. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `low` | Informational; no immediate enforcement implication. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
